title: Wedding and Banquet Enquiry Qualification
summary: Qualify wedding and banquet enquiries on WhatsApp and calls: dates, functions, guest counts, menus and rooms, checked against the venue calendar, with indicative packages and visits booked.

seo.title: Wedding and Banquet Enquiry Qualification AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that qualifies wedding and banquet enquiries by date, functions, guest count, menu and rooms, checks the venue calendar and books visits for sales.

problem.intro: Wedding and banquet enquiries arrive from venue listing sites, Instagram, Google, referrals and walk-ins, and most begin with the same message: what is your rate? A useful answer depends on the date, the functions, guest count per function, menu, rooms for the wedding party and decor. Sales managers spend their day collecting these details from families who are comparing many venues.

pain_points.title: Rate questions without context
pain_points.detail: Per-plate prices and venue rent depend on date, menu and guest count, so a quick number either scares the family away or sets the wrong expectation.

pain_points.title: Auspicious dates clash
pain_points.detail: Popular muhurat dates draw many enquiries for the same lawn or hall, and tentative holds without follow-up block dates that never convert.

pain_points.title: Multi-function events are complex
pain_points.detail: Mehendi, haldi, sangeet, wedding and reception may need different spaces, menus and timings, plus a room block for guests.

pain_points.title: Leads lost between calls
pain_points.detail: Families call back after visiting other venues, and without notes on what they wanted, the conversation starts again from scratch.

solution.overview: We build an enquiry assistant for WhatsApp and phone that collects what the banquet team needs before a quote. It asks about the event, dates and flexibility, functions, guest count per function, veg, non-veg or Jain menus, budget per plate, rooms for the wedding party, decor and music. It checks the venue calendar for the lawn and halls, explains what is free on those dates and gives an indicative package range from your approved rate card, clearly labelled as indicative. Qualified families are offered a venue visit or food tasting. The banquet manager receives a structured summary and score, and decides whether to place a tentative hold with an expiry date.
capabilities: Structured capture of event type, dates, functions, guest counts and menu preferences
Venue calendar check for lawns, halls and room blocks on requested dates
Indicative package ranges from your approved rate card, never final quotes
Venue visit and food tasting bookings with reminders
Lead scoring by date fit, budget fit and decision stage
Tentative hold tracking with expiry reminders to the family and the sales team

workflow.title: Capture the enquiry
workflow.detail: Enquiries from listings, Instagram, Google, calls and walk-ins are logged in one place with their source.

workflow.title: Collect event details
workflow.detail: The assistant asks about dates, functions, guests, menus, rooms and budget in Hindi or English, by chat or call.

workflow.title: Check the calendar
workflow.detail: Requested dates are checked against the venue calendar for each space and against the room inventory.

workflow.title: Share an indicative range
workflow.detail: An indicative package range is shared from the approved rate card, and alternative dates are offered if spaces are taken.

workflow.title: Book a visit
workflow.detail: Qualified families are offered a venue visit or tasting, and the banquet manager receives a summary.

workflow.title: Manage holds and follow-up
workflow.detail: The manager decides on tentative holds and quotes, and the assistant tracks expiry and reminds both sides.

inputs: Enquiries from venue listings, Instagram, Google, calls and walk-ins
Banquet calendar for lawns and halls
Room inventory for wedding party blocks
Approved rate card, menus and packages
Banquet manager availability for visits and tastings
outputs: Structured enquiry record with event details per function
Lead score and recommended next step
Enquiry reports by source, date demand and outcome
human_in_the_loop: The banquet manager prepares every final quote, approves tentative holds and handles negotiation. The assistant shares only indicative ranges from the approved rate card and hands over as soon as a family wants to negotiate or confirm.
integrations: Banquet or event management software, or a shared calendar
CRM or Google Sheets for enquiry tracking
guardrails: Indicative ranges always labelled as indicative and subject to the final quote
No date confirmed or held without the banquet manager's approval
Calendar checked live before any date is described as available
Family contact details shared only with the sales team
Immediate handover for negotiation, complaints or VIP requests
compliance_notes: Business-initiated WhatsApp follow-ups use approved templates and opt-in under Meta's policies.
Enquiry details are processed for event planning, with retention limits, under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: All WhatsApp and phone enquiries for one venue over a period that includes a few auspicious dates, with the banquet manager reviewing every summary.
deliverables: Enquiry flow and event detail schema
Banquet manager summary and hold screen

what_we_measure.how: Enquiries where date, functions, guest count and menu were captured before handover.
Visits booked from assistant-handled enquiries, and whether they took place.
Time spent before the first quote, compared with enquiries from before the pilot.
Tentative holds released at expiry rather than left blocking dates.

faqs.q: Will it give families our prices?
faqs.a: Only indicative ranges you approve, such as a per-plate range for a menu tier, and only once it knows the date and guest count. Final quotes always come from your banquet manager.

faqs.q: Can it handle multi-day weddings with several functions?
faqs.a: Yes. It records each function separately with date, time, space, guest count and menu, and checks each against the calendar. The summary shows the whole event at a glance.

faqs.q: Does it work for corporate events and birthdays too?
faqs.a: Yes. The flow adapts by event type, asking about seating style, AV and timings for corporate events, or theme and cake for birthdays, while using the same calendar and rate card.

faqs.q: Can families speak to it by phone?
faqs.a: Yes. The same qualification runs as a voice conversation in Hindi or English, and the details reach the banquet manager in the same format as WhatsApp enquiries.
